column1: # asset-content-tests.tsv — the tests that READ Cargo-inert instruction .md (#8378).
# capabilities-drift.yml runs exactly these on a Cargo-inert instruction-content
# diff, where `Rust tests (affected crates)` plans nothing (owner ruling
# under crates/trusty-mpm/src/assets, and content/** (the agents and harness
# docs since #9011). A reader of any other asset (a hook script, a TOML or JSON
# file, trusty-code's own copies) needs no row: an edit to that asset is code,
# so its crate's tests run in the affected-crates job.
# scripts/check_asset_test_filter.py `check` fails that job when test code
# reads such an asset outside this list; `run` executes it and fails on a row
# that selects no test. A `runtime:` row is one the static guard cannot see:
# the test reaches the .md through a run-time lookup, so the row is kept by hand.
# Columns (TAB-separated): crate, target, filter, reason[, features].
#   filter  `*` = the whole target; else a test-path prefix (module or test).
#   features  optional: `--features` the target's build needs (empty default set).
# A module row covers every test in it, including ones added later; a test
# row covers only that test. Prefer a test row in a large, slow module.
